The '''RX4 Patrol Ship''' was a vessel used by the [[Trianii Rangers]] for long term patrols of [[Trianii Space/Legends|Trianii Space]]. Due to the family nature of Trianii Rangers, these ships had a much more homey interior than was usual for military vessels. Though not a heavy combat vessel, it was more than capable of dealing with the small-time smugglers and pirates that operated in Trianii space.
